thread:
maya_sales: Heads-up — Epoch Retail POC can't create Dedicated reservation in us-west2. UI returns 'INSUFFICIENT_GPU_QUOTA'. Customer stuck on benchmark step.

devin_se: Paste the full API payload and error blob please. How many GPUs and what AZ spread?

maya_sales: Payload was for 6xA10g across 3 AZs (to get 2 workers per AZ). Error: 'googleapis: resourceQuotaExceeded: requested 6 gpus, available 0 for region us-west2'.

janet_platform: Quick check — is this our internal pool depletion or cloud provider quota? @ksd-quota-bot can you reconcile project vs platform capacity?

ksd-quota-bot: Auto-check: Project epoch-retail-demo shows 0 regional GPUs available for A10g in us-west2. Platform reserved capacity in that region is 0 for demo tier. Recommend: open cloud quota increase and consider switching to dedicated trial pool in us-central1 if acceptable.

tom_sre: Two practical options: 1) request a regional quota raise from GCP (48-72h typical), 2) temp launch smaller reservation (1-2 GPUs) for sanity tests if provider allows. Also confirm billing account & org policy don't block quota.

anita_cs: Customer's compliance team won't allow moving region. They also submitted security questionnaire asking about isolation for Dedicated pools and KMS integration. Any quick answers?

devin_se: For KMS: we support customer-managed keys for Private, but Hosted/Dedicated POC can demo with platform-managed keys. I'll add a note in the questionnaire: Dedicated supports CMEK in Private deployments; for Hosted/Dedicated during POC we can discuss contract terms.

maya_sales: Pricing question from buyer: if we reduce reservation size during POC and then upgrade, do we still get POC discounted pricing or is it pro-rated? Need clear answer for procurement.

janet_platform: POC pricing is pro-rated based on committed reservation hours. We can offer a 2-week courtesy discount on the initial commit for POCs — talk to commercial. I'll draft a short note.

tom_sre: Small gotcha — some tenants have org-level quota restrictions; even if platform has capacity, the customer's GCP project can block GPU creation. Ask them to confirm project id and whether they filed a service quota request.

maya_sales: They've opened a GCP quota request but no ETA. I'll ask for project id and billing id. Meanwhile can we try a single-AZ 2xA10g reservation to at least run smoke tests?

devin_se: API snippet to try single-AZ smaller reservation:
```
POST /v1/dedicated/reservations
{
  "region": "us-west2",
  "gpu_sku": "a10g",
  "count": 2,
  "az_affinity": "single-az",
  "commit_term": "hourly"
}
```
If GCP quota is 0 you'll still see an error.

anita_cs: I'll coordinate messaging and queue up the security questionnaire response with the KMS/ISO notes. Also looping legal for the data residency clause.

tom_sre: I'll standby to escalate to GCP support if you share project id. Also will check platform logs to ensure we're not hitting internal allocation bug.

maya_sales: Thanks team — I'll get project id, billing details, and the purchaser's acceptance on a temporary single-AZ smoke. Will update once they confirm.
